evidence.title: ProxyFormer: A Dual-Stream Proxy Architecture for Ultra-Long Context and High-Resolution Generation

summary: A new AI architecture called ProxyFormer uses a dual-stream proxy design to enable ultra-long context understanding and high-resolution generation. The approach aims to improve efficiency and scalability in large language and vision models.
title: Researchers Introduce ProxyFormer: A Dual-Stream Architecture for Ultra-Long Context AI Models
